description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Decouple business logic from the routing layer for better testability
Use descriptive function names that indicate side effects
Ensure all public functions have corresponding unit tests
Use bulk inserts instead of looping single inserts when writing to the database
Validate all incoming API payloads against a strict schema
Consistently use either tabs or spaces (spaces preferred in Python/JS)
Apply dependency injection to make components easier to mock
